description: Agent-ready signals from Polymarket's live public market data, not a raw passthrough: top open markets by trailing volume, the biggest consensus shifts, which markets entered or left the top 100, and a 0-100 liquidity and spread quality score with reasons. POST /v1/top-markets, /v1/market-momentum, /v1/rotation-diff or /v1/market-quality with a small JSON body and get one JSON object back. Results vary with live data (3-minute cache). Independent project, not affiliated with Polymarket. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Options for POST /v1/top-markets (other routes take similar small bodies; see the OpenAPI document).

limit.description: How many markets to return, e.g. 10.

outputSchema.description: For POST /v1/top-markets, a JSON object with service, fetched_at, cache, window, ranked_by, candidate_pool_size, count and a markets array (question, outcomes, prices, volumes, liquidity, spread, rank). The other routes return their own JSON objects (momentum shifts, rotation entries/exits with an insufficient_history flag, quality scores with reasons). Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400). Published schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/organiccryptoyyc/pocket-agentic-services/main/prediction-market-intel/openapi.json

responseSummary.note: Abridged; captured on Pocket MainNet 2026-10-04 (top market by 1-month volume, about $12.75M).
